text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's the end of our shopping, yep. 
Alright, let's head back to the academy 
and—

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, get your fresh shijimi 
clams! How about some for tonight's 
dinner?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Clams! Wow, today they have clams from all 
kinds of regions!

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's rare to get freshwater 
clams from all over the country like this. 
Their flavors actually differ depending on 
where they're from!

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
Take these Yamato clams harvested in 
Aomori, for instance! Every single one is 
nice and plump, and the umami bursting in 
your mouth is irresistible!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I love freshwater clams. I can't believe 
there are so many varieties here. Since 
I'm here... maybe I'll try them all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I saw Win Variation lining up 
several dishes on a table.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Clam ramen, clam pilaf, clam miso soup... 
Wow, everything is clam-based.
choice_data_list: Why are there so many clam dishes...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. I was thinking of doing a 
shijimi clam taste test.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Unusually enough, they had all kinds of 
shijimi clams from across the country for 
sale."
choice_data_list:
Still, feels like the portion might be a 
bit too big...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, it's my favorite, so it's fine. I can 
finish this in a flash!
choice_data_list:
If we're doing a taste comparison, a small 
portion is plenty.

Then you should eat it all and savor it to 
your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Still, I ended up cooking so much food...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I know! I'll share some with the others so 
they can taste how delicious shijimi clams 
are too, ssul!

Whoa, whoa whoa whoa...! It's the grand 
opening of the Ultimate Shellfish 
Championship!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, first up is Gol-pippi's turn! I 
draw... "Whelk"!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Talk about crunchy—it's like a 90-minute 
full-body massage! Bring on the clams or 
whatever else you got!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um, me too...! I want to try freshwater 
clams! As fellow shellfish, surf clams 
won't lose either!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
An outstanding chewy texture and sweetness 
that fills your entire mouth! That's 
Tomakomai's gourmet specialty: surf clams!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you definitely should! The taste and 
texture vary depending on where they're 
harvested. Let's savor the deliciousness 
of shijimi clams together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation, together with Gold Ship and 
the others, sampled and compared a 
sensible amount of clam dishes.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yes! Today's a clam festival!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wah. These freshwater clams have great 
flavor... The broth comes through so 
nicely, it's really rich!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
These clams here are so plump and 
satisfying to eat. They go perfectly with 
rice!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I polished it all off in no time. 
Every single clam was so delicious, I just 
couldn't stop eating.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Next time, maybe we could look into 
whether there are any freshwater clam 
desserts.
